blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas women’s beach volleyball young stars Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara barely broke a sweat in routing Mongolia’s Khandsuren Gantogtokh and Tsolmon Batjargal, 21-3, 21-3, to stay unbeaten in Pool G of the Asian Games on Wednesday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Progella and Pagara wrapped up their match in just 21 minutes to take a 2-0 lead in Pool G, moving closer to the round of 16.
